cc:Work.dc:title: KDAB Runway 07L approach line profile
cc:Work.dc:description: Approach-ID trajectories without a sustained altitude hold plotted as colored line segments. The x coordinate is distance_to_threshold_ft, the y coordinate is geoaltitude_ft, and segment color is lateral_dev_ft.
